intro: California's knowledge test is multiple choice and based on the California Driver's Handbook. California DMV states a passing score of 80%.

testTypes.name: Regular driver (Class C)
testTypes.description: Knowledge test for the standard passenger-vehicle permit and license.

notes: California DMV states a passing score of 80%. The pages we verified do not state the number of questions, so our mock uses a practice length and is scored at 80%.
In-office knowledge tests must be started before 4:30 p.m.

mockPresets.label: Class C mock test
mockPresets.description: 30 mixed questions scored at California's stated 80% passing score.

commonMistakes.text: Turning at a red arrow. A red arrow means stop — you cannot turn on it, even after stopping.
commonMistakes.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Red Arrow

commonMistakes.text: Treating a flashing yellow like a stop. You don't need to stop — slow down and proceed with caution.
commonMistakes.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Flashing Yellow Light

commonMistakes.text: Forgetting that school-bus red lights require a stop from either direction unless the bus is across a divided or multilane highway.
commonMistakes.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Around Children

commonMistakes.text: Mixing up the 15 mph limits: blind intersections, alleys, and some railroad crossings are all 15 mph; school zones are 25 mph unless posted lower.
commonMistakes.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued)

faq.q: What score do I need to pass the California knowledge test?
faq.a: California DMV states that the passing score is 80%. The test is multiple choice and based on the California Driver's Handbook.

faq.q: How old do I have to be to get a California learner's permit?
faq.a: Applicants under 18 must be at least 15½ and meet the driver-education requirements. Adults 18 and over may also apply for an instruction permit.

faq.q: When can I take the knowledge test at a DMV office?
faq.a: In-office knowledge tests must be started before 4:30 p.m. during DMV business hours.

faq.q: Are these the real California DMV test questions?
faq.a: No. These are original practice questions written from the official California Driver's Handbook. Each one links to the handbook section it is based on.

questions.question: In California, when may you turn right at a solid red traffic light?
options: After stopping at the limit line and yielding, if no NO TURN ON RED sign is posted
Never — you must wait for a green light
Only when a green arrow is also lit
Without stopping, if no pedestrians are present
questions.correctAnswer: After stopping at the limit line and yielding, if no NO TURN ON RED sign is posted
questions.explanation: A red light means stop, but you may turn right after stopping at the stop or limit line, yielding to pedestrians, and turning when safe — unless a NO TURN ON RED sign is posted.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Traffic Signals: Solid Red Light

questions.question: What does a red arrow signal mean?
options: You may turn after a full stop if the way is clear
Proceed with caution in the direction of the arrow
The protected turn is about to begin
Stop and do not turn until a green light or green arrow appears
questions.correctAnswer: Stop and do not turn until a green light or green arrow appears
questions.explanation: A red arrow means STOP. Do not turn at a red arrow; remain stopped until a green traffic signal light or green arrow appears.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Traffic Signals: Red Arrow

questions.question: What must you do at a flashing red signal light?
options: Slow down; you do not need to stop
Stop and wait for the light to turn green
Speed up to clear the intersection
Stop, then go when it is safe
questions.correctAnswer: Stop, then go when it is safe
questions.explanation: A flashing red signal light means STOP. After stopping, you may go when it is safe.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Traffic Signals: Flashing Red Light

questions.question: A flashing yellow traffic signal light means:
options: The light is about to turn green
Slow down and proceed with caution — you do not need to stop
Yield to traffic on your left only
questions.correctAnswer: Slow down and proceed with caution — you do not need to stop
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light is a warning to proceed with caution. Slow down and be alert; you do not need to stop.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Traffic Signals: Flashing Yellow Light

questions.question: You approach an intersection where the traffic light is not working. What should you do?
options: Proceed at normal speed if no one is coming
Yield only to vehicles on your right
Treat it like a flashing yellow light
Stop as if the intersection had STOP signs in all directions
questions.correctAnswer: Stop as if the intersection had STOP signs in all directions
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is not working, stop as if the intersection is controlled by STOP signs in all directions, then proceed cautiously when safe.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Traffic Signals: Traffic Light Not Working

questions.question: A pedestrian is still crossing while the pedestrian signal shows a flashing "Don't Walk." What must you do?
options: Proceed, because the signal tells them not to walk
Drive around the pedestrian if there is room
questions.explanation: A flashing Don't Walk signal tells pedestrians not to start crossing, but drivers must still yield to pedestrians even if the Don't Walk light is flashing.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Pedestrian Signals and Signs

questions.question: A 5-sided (pentagon-shaped) sign means you are:
options: Near a school — drive slowly and stop for children in the crosswalk
questions.correctAnswer: Near a school — drive slowly and stop for children in the crosswalk
questions.explanation: A 5-sided sign means you are near a school. Drive slowly and stop for children in the crosswalk.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Signs: 5-sided Sign

questions.question: Driving at night, how can you tell you have entered a road going the wrong way?
options: Road reflectors shine blue in your headlights
The center line becomes solid white
Road reflectors shine red in your headlights
questions.correctAnswer: Road reflectors shine red in your headlights
questions.explanation: If you are driving the wrong way at night, the road reflectors will shine red in your headlights. DO NOT ENTER and WRONG WAY signs may also be posted.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Signs: WRONG WAY Sign

questions.question: A round yellow-and-black sign or an X-shaped sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A yellow and black circular sign or an X-shaped sign means you are approaching a railroad crossing. Look, listen, slow down, and prepare to stop.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Signs: Yellow and Black Circular Sign or X-shaped Sign

questions.question: What does a red circle with a red line through it mean?
options: You are entering a school zone
The action shown inside the circle is not allowed
questions.correctAnswer: The action shown inside the circle is not allowed
questions.explanation: The picture inside a red circle with a red line through it shows what you cannot do, and may be shown with words.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Signs: Red Circle with a Red Line Through It

questions.question: Diamond-shaped signs:
options: Warn you of specific road conditions and dangers ahead
Mark the location of services like gas
questions.correctAnswer: Warn you of specific road conditions and dangers ahead
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn you of specific road conditions and dangers ahead.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Signs: Diamond-shaped Sign

questions.question: At an intersection without STOP or YIELD signs, you and another vehicle arrive at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?
questions.explanation: Without STOP or YIELD signs, the first vehicle to arrive has the right-of-way. If another vehicle, pedestrian, or bicyclist arrives at the same time, give the right-of-way to the one on your right.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Right-of-Way Rules: Intersections

questions.question: At a T intersection without STOP or YIELD signs, who has the right-of-way?
options: Vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians on the through road
Vehicles on the road that ends
Whoever arrives first, regardless of road
questions.correctAnswer: Vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians on the through road
questions.explanation: At T intersections without STOP or YIELD signs, those on the through road (continuing straight) have the right-of-way.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Right-of-Way Rules: Intersections

questions.question: Two vehicles meet on a steep, narrow mountain road where neither can pass. Which vehicle has the right-of-way?
options: The vehicle closest to a turnout
questions.explanation: The vehicle facing uphill has the right-of-way. The vehicle facing downhill has more control when backing up, so it should back up until the uphill vehicle can pass.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Right-of-Way Rules: Mountain Roads

questions.question: When entering a roundabout, you must:
options: Yield to all traffic already in the roundabout
Expect traffic in the roundabout to yield to you
questions.correctAnswer: Yield to all traffic already in the roundabout
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach, yield to all traffic already in the roundabout, and travel counter-clockwise without stopping or passing.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Right-of-Way Rules: Roundabouts

questions.question: A blind pedestrian at an intersection pulls in their cane and steps away from the curb. This usually means:
options: You must wait for a green light
questions.explanation: When a blind person pulls in their cane and steps away from the intersection, the gesture usually means you may go. Never honk at a blind person.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road — Pedestrians: Pedestrians who are Blind

questions.question: According to the California handbook, a large vehicle traveling 55 mph can take up to how many feet to stop?
questions.explanation: An average passenger vehicle at 55 mph can stop within 300 feet; a large vehicle at the same speed can take up to 400 feet.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Sharing the Road: Braking

questions.question: A bus or streetcar is stopped at a safety zone. What is the maximum speed at which you may pass it?
questions.explanation: When a bus, streetcar, or trolley is stopped at a safety zone or traffic light, you may pass at no more than 10 mph. Never drive through a safety zone.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Buses, Streetcars, Trolleys

questions.question: What following distance does the handbook recommend behind a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Allow a safe three-second following distance behind motorcyclists so you can avoid hitting them if they brake suddenly or fall.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Motorcycles

questions.question: It is against the law to follow within how many feet of a fire engine, police vehicle, or ambulance using its siren or flashing lights?
questions.explanation: It is against the law to follow within 300 feet of any fire engine, law enforcement vehicle, ambulance, or other emergency vehicle when its siren or flashing lights are on.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Emergency Vehicles

questions.question: If you cannot change lanes to pass a bicyclist, how much space must you leave?
questions.explanation: When you cannot change lanes to pass a bicyclist, allow at least three feet between your vehicle and the bicyclist. If you can't, don't pass until you can.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Bicycles: Passing a Bicyclist

questions.question: How far before a turn may you enter a bike lane?
options: No more than 200 feet before starting the turn
Never — bike lanes may not be entered
questions.correctAnswer: No more than 200 feet before starting the turn
questions.explanation: When preparing to turn, merge safely behind any bicyclist and enter a bike lane no more than 200 feet before starting the turn.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Bicycles: Passing a Bicyclist

questions.question: Fines for traffic violations in a California work zone can be:
questions.explanation: Fines for traffic violations in a work zone can be $1,000 or more, and fines are doubled in certain zones and when workers are present.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Road Workers and Work Zones: Fines and Double Fine Zones

questions.question: Unless otherwise posted, what is the speed limit within 500 feet of a school while children are outside or crossing?
questions.explanation: The speed limit is 25 mph within 500 feet of a school while children are outside or crossing the street. Some school zones may be as low as 15 mph.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Around Children

questions.question: A school bus ahead is flashing red lights. What must you do?
options: Stop from either direction and remain stopped while the red lights flash
Slow to 15 mph and pass carefully
Stop only if you are behind the bus
Stop only if children are visible
questions.correctAnswer: Stop from either direction and remain stopped while the red lights flash
questions.explanation: When the bus flashes red lights you must stop from either direction until the children are safely across and the lights stop flashing. Failing to stop can mean a fine of up to $1,000 and a one-year suspension.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Around Children

questions.question: When do you NOT need to stop for a school bus flashing red lights?
options: When it is on the other side of a divided or multilane highway (two or more lanes each way)
When the bus is stopped on a two-lane road
questions.correctAnswer: When it is on the other side of a divided or multilane highway (two or more lanes each way)
questions.explanation: If the school bus is on the other side of a divided or multilane highway (two or more lanes in each direction), you do not need to stop.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Around Children

questions.question: What is the speed limit at a blind intersection in California?
questions.explanation: An intersection is blind if it has no stop signs at any corner and your view is blocked. The speed limit for a blind intersection is 15 mph.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Blind Intersections

questions.question: What is the speed limit in an alley?
questions.explanation: An alley is a road no wider than 25 feet used to reach the rear or side entrances of properties. The speed limit in an alley is 15 mph.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Alleys

questions.question: When crossing devices warn that a train is coming, you must stop at least how far from the nearest track?
questions.explanation: When crossing devices or a person warn you a train is coming, stop at least 15 feet from the nearest track.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Near Railroad or Light Rail Tracks

questions.question: The 15 mph railroad speed limit applies within 100 feet of a crossing when:
options: You cannot see the tracks for 400 feet in both directions
questions.correctAnswer: You cannot see the tracks for 400 feet in both directions
questions.explanation: The speed limit is 15 mph within 100 feet of a railroad crossing where you cannot see the tracks for 400 feet in both directions. You may go faster if the crossing has gates, a warning signal, or a flagman.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Near Railroad or Light Rail Tracks

questions.question: Unless otherwise posted, the speed limit in a business or residential district is:
questions.explanation: In business or residential districts the speed limit is 25 mph unless otherwise posted.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Business or Residential Districts

questions.question: Neighborhood electric vehicles (NEVs) and low-speed vehicles are restricted from roads where the speed limit is greater than:
questions.explanation: NEVs and LSVs reach a maximum speed of 25 mph and are restricted from roads where the speed limit is greater than 35 mph.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Neighborhood Electric Vehicles (NEV) and Low-speed Vehicles (LSV)

questions.question: A truck displays a diamond-shaped hazardous-load placard. What must it do at railroad tracks?
options: Turn on its hazard lights and continue
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped sign on a truck means its load may be dangerous. Vehicles with these signs must stop before crossing railroad tracks.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Vehicles with Hazardous Loads

questions.question: When you are towing a vehicle or trailer, which lane must you drive in?
options: The far-right lane or a lane marked for slower vehicles
questions.correctAnswer: The far-right lane or a lane marked for slower vehicles
questions.explanation: When towing a vehicle or trailer you must drive in the far-right lane or a lane marked for slower vehicles. With four or more lanes and none marked, use only the two right-hand lanes.
questions.sourceSection: Section 7: Laws and Rules of the Road (Continued) — Towing

questions.question: What is the minimum age to apply for a California provisional instruction permit?
questions.explanation: To apply for a California instruction permit under age 18, you must be at least 15½ but under 18 and meet the driver-education requirements.
questions.sourceSection: To apply for a California Instruction Permit (under age 18)

questions.question: What passing score does California DMV state for the knowledge test?
questions.explanation: California DMV states that the knowledge test uses multiple-choice questions based on the California Driver's Handbook and the passing score is 80%.
questions.sourceSection: Take the knowledge test(s)

questions.question: Under California's minimum financial responsibility rules, what is the minimum coverage for damage to property?
questions.explanation: California requires minimum limits of $30,000 for injury/death to one person, $60,000 for injury/death to more than one person, and $15,000 for property damage.
questions.sourceSection: FAQs — What is Financial Responsibility (Insurance)?
